authorship_disclosure: Same-team CPU record analysis by the author of production data/evaluation/statistics/report code; not blind implementation review or independent GPU replication. No additional model work. This supplements, not replaces, the complete validity, source-identity and work-ledger audits.

definitions.native_nonempty_valid_blocks: no_error_blocks + sum(first_error_position_1..15), from one original training forward; contiguous native proposal chains stop at gaps or canonical EOS
definitions.native_kept_anchor_occurrences: sum of the actual native sampler keep_mask; distinct from nonempty block validity and from allocated slots
definitions.native_allocated_slots: actual sampled position array width, at most 512 per response; not assumed to equal 512
definitions.available_supervised_position_occurrence: positive native validity-weight occurrences before first-error selection; occurrences, not unique token identities
definitions.selected_supervised_position_occurrences: native current correct prefix through first mismatch; equals supervised_position_exposure; K+ redistributes weights without changing this count
definitions.selector_valid_score_blocks: separate up-to-16-anchor score denominator for STATIC64/PROGRESS64 only; null for unscored policies, never interpreted as zero native training exposure
definitions.logical_vs_physical: event 1 SHARED pass 1 contributes to every policy logically but once to physical totals; qualification is separate
definitions.timing: Event-1 policy worker_wall_s excludes the earlier shared worker; logical_updater_s includes its attributed pass (and score work where applicable). Pass wall includes setup and packet loading; per-response training_compute_s retains the narrower native timer. Logical updater is training pass wall plus scoring worker wall plus selection time. Worker wall is reported separately and includes other phases; nested timers must not be added.
definitions.aggregation: Sum response_observation.sum_metrics once per forward. Optimizer-boundary metrics only cross-check counts, since other metrics rows would double-count accumulation windows.
